messages:
carla_cs: Quick pattern from 3 onboarding calls today: customers get blocked on API key rotation UI (they expect a seamless swap, but current flow requires creating a new key then re-deploying routes) AND one customer reported their semantic search degraded after switching embedding model versions. Two accounts are flagged as higher churn risk. We need a tiny capture flow so CSMs can file both types of feedback separately but with identical metadata.

lisa_enablement: Seen the key rotation confusion too during live demos 1. People expect a 'rotate' button that keeps routes alive. Also on embedding model swaps, they expect a compatibility note. A short Slack modal would save time 1 and help us collect repro steps.

ben_product: Agreed. Let's capture two distinct problem types: (A) key rotation UX, (B) embedding model compatibility. Minimal modal fields: customer/org, contact, account age, problem type (dropdown), concise symptom, repro steps, route/model name, whether they switched models recently, severity suggestion, attachments. If we start seeing similar phrasing across captures we'll bump to a quick design patch.

owen_eng: For engineer handoff, include: deployment (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), sample request ids (if available), and whether the customer stores keys in a secret manager. I can add logic in the webhook to attach last 24h request summary when an account id is provided.

carla_cs: Proposed modal copy (single-step):
```
Problem type: key-rotation / embedding-compatibility / other
Customer (org + contact):
Account age (days):
Symptom (one line):
Steps to reproduce (short bullets):
Route or model (if applicable):
Switched model recently? yes/no
Deployment: Hosted / Dedicated / Private
Sample request id (optional):
Attach: screenshot / log link
Suggested priority: low / medium / high
```

lisa_enablement: Perfect. I'll tell the onboarding team to use it tomorrow. If we can auto-tag captures with "onboard-key-rotation" or "onboard-embed-compat" in tracker that would speed routing.

capture_bot: New capture created: CF-2026-554 "Key rotation breaks active routes" 1 submitted by carla_cs. Link: https://tracker.internal/CF-2026-554

ben_product: I'll create the tracker tags and schedule a 20-min triage tomorrow. If we get 3+ captures referencing the same sentence ("routes go 404 after rotate") in 7 days, escalate to P1 UX.

owen_eng: I'll build the Slack shortcut + webhook tonight and include the diagnostic payload option. @carla_cs can you DM a safe test account id so I can validate the request-summary attach?

carla_cs: Sent test id in DM. Thanks team 44d 1 1 1 1 1 1 1 aiming to have the shortcut live by EOD so enablement can use it in tomorrow's sessions.
